I have owned this small plot for many years and I know the soil stays fertile if I add cow manure from our animals. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive and hard to find at the cooperative, especially for a small plot like this, so I will rely on compost and our own family labor. We will plant the seeds we saved from last season because they grow well here and cost us nothing. Since the rains should come soon, I do not need irrigation, and my children and I can manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting without paying for outside help.
